title: The kb MCP coord_wait cap of 60 seconds is skipped for a string timeout
goal: kb_mcp refuses a coord_wait timeout that is not a number of at most 60 as a tool error before coord.py runs

run:
import json,os,sys,tempfile
os.environ['KB_COORD_STORE']=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'c.sqlite');os.environ.pop('KB_COORD_URL',None)
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kb_mcp
call=lambda n,a:(kb_mcp.handle({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':'tools/call','params':{'name':n,'arguments':a}}).get('result') or {})
call('coord_post',{'kind':'heartbeat','fields':{'session':'repro'}})
r=call('coord_wait',{'since':0,'timeout':'100'})
print(json.dumps(r)[:300]);sys.exit(0 if r.get('isError') is True else 1)

clauses.clause: kb_mcp refuses a coord_wait timeout that is not a number of at most 60 as a tool error before coord.py runs

notes: Goal before the 2026-10-17 plan: SP-xo45jvbj review G7 (ST-xwop6rv5, gate g4): kb_mcp checks the coord_wait cap only for an int or float timeout, so a client that does not validate the schema sends "timeout": "100" and coord.py accepts it, holding the single-threaded server up to COORD_RUN_S. A timeout that is not a number of at most 60 is refused as a tool error before coord.py runs. Plan 2026-10-17: repro on origin/main b871374b4 exits 1 (a string timeout reaches coord.py).
